command.description: One agent-browser subcommand to run. Common commands include "open"/"goto"/"navigate", "snapshot", "click", "dblclick", "focus", "type", "fill", "press", "hover", "select", "check", "uncheck", "scroll", "drag", "upload", "screenshot", "pdf", "get", "is", "find", "wait", "batch", "clipboard", "mouse", "set", "cookies", "storage", "network", "tab", "window", "frame", "dialog", "diff", "trace", "profiler", "console", "errors", "state", "back", "forward", "reload", "pushstate", "react", "vitals", "stream", "connect", "chat", "session", "doctor", or "close".

args.description: Arguments for agent-browser. Put URLs, refs such as @e2, selectors, filenames, text, subcommand arguments, and flags here. OpenCTO places known global flags before the command. Common global flags include --json, --headed, --debug, --profile, --state, --headers, --session-name, --executable-path, --extension, --init-script, --enable, --args, --user-agent, --proxy, --proxy-bypass, --ignore-https-errors, --allow-file-access, -p/--provider, --device, --annotate, --screenshot-dir, --screenshot-quality, --screenshot-format, --cdp, --auto-connect, --color-scheme, --download-path, --content-boundaries, --max-output, --allowed-domains, --action-policy, --confirm-actions, --confirm-interactive, --engine, --no-auto-dialog, --model, -v/--verbose, -q/--quiet, and --config. Use equivalent CLI flags for agent-browser config fields such as headed, json, debug, profile, state, proxy, userAgent, provider, device, engine, screenshotDir, allowedDomains, maxOutput, and noAutoDialog. Never include --session here; use the session field.

session.description: Human-readable browser session name for this browsing flow, using only letters, numbers, and dashes, for example appstore-login or stripe-dashboard. For a new browser flow, choose a meaningful non-empty name. OpenCTO runs it as opencto-<project_id>-<session>. If continuing a browser flow, reuse the same session value or the returned browser_session value. Use an empty string only when no meaningful browser flow name is available; OpenCTO then uses opencto-<project_id>.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum runtime for this browser action in milliseconds. Use 0 to accept OpenCTO's runtime default. agent-browser operations also have their own default action timeout.

idempotency.description: Classify whether rerunning this browser action is safe. Use read_only for inspection, idempotent for safe repeatable actions, non_idempotent for one-shot or mutating actions, and unknown when unsure.

description.description: One sentence describing what this browser action achieves. Use an empty string when the command itself is self-explanatory.

destructive.description: Set true when the browser action mutates state in a risky or hard-to-reverse way. Use false otherwise.
